changeSet.author: eop
changeSet.comment: Add CHECK constraint to ensure player.seat_order is within the valid range 0..5. This bound is derived from GameSession.MAXIMUM_PLAYERS = 6, so valid seats are 0 through 5 inclusive. This single CHECK fixes the seat range on hand and trick_play too, because fk_hand_player_seat and fk_trick_play_player_seat bind those columns to player (id, seat_order) and therefore inherit whatever player permits. See ADR-023 line 1192.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE player ADD CONSTRAINT chk_player_seat_order CHECK (seat_order BETWEEN 0 AND 5)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE player DROP CONSTRAINT chk_player_seat_order

changeSet.author: eop
changeSet.comment: Add CHECK constraint to ensure trick.sequence is 1-based as documented in changeset 004. No upper bound is derivable: at three players a session has 26 tricks, but no domain constant bounds it.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE trick ADD CONSTRAINT chk_trick_sequence CHECK (sequence >= 1)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE trick DROP CONSTRAINT chk_trick_sequence

changeSet.author: eop
changeSet.comment: Add CHECK constraint to ensure game_session.current_leader_seat is within the valid range 0..5, or NULL. The column was added in changeset 004 and is nullable because it is unset in LOBBY and written at deal completion.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE game_session ADD CONSTRAINT chk_game_session_current_leader_seat CHECK (current_leader_seat IS NULL OR current_leader_seat BETWEEN 0 AND 5)

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE game_session DROP CONSTRAINT chk_game_session_current_leader_seat
